thread:
anya: FYI ACME support ping — their checkout POST is returning intermittent 503s during the payment step since 09:02 UTC. They included a request-id `req-20260317-090223` and say failures spike on a promo burst. Raising here because logs hint at upstream inference failure during the auth token enrichment step.

mike: Can you paste the customer's example request/response and the node/container ids? Also which model variant was routed for that route?

anya: Example: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXXX' -d '{"user_id":"123","items":...}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/checkout -> 503 {"error":"upstream inference failed","request_id":"req-20260317-090223"}`
Node: host-45.internal, container: c7f3b2a1, route: checkout-enrich (model: gptx-13b-quant-v2). Logs attached from customer show "upstream: abort (segfault)" and a short stack.

ops-bot: ALERT host-45: infer-runner container restarted 3 times in 5m. Crash reason: SIGSEGV (code 11). NVML: memory peak 31.9GB (GPU0). OOM killer not invoked at kernel level; process crashed inside runtime.

jason: Please grab these from host-45: `sudo journalctl -u infer-runner -o short-iso | tail -n 200`, `kubectl -n hosted describe pod infer-runner-host-45`, and `sudo dmesg | tail -n 100`. Also check `/var/crash` for core dumps and `nvcrash` logs.

mike: Early hypothesis: autoscaler triggered a hot model swap (quant variant -> higher-memory variant) during the promo spike and concurrent long-context requests caused KV cache blowup + kernel selection path that triggers segfault in the quant runtime. Repro plan: run loadtest with 20 concurrent requests at 8k context against gptx-13b-quant-v2 with model-swap enabled. If we reproduce, change autoscaler burst policy and pin the route to smaller variant.

sara: Mitigations for customer now: 1) route checkout-enrich to fallback small-embed model (checkout-enrich-fallback) — done, ~5% cheaper, stable. 2) increased reserved capacity for the route for 30m to absorb promo traffic. 3) asked billing to hold charge attempts for impacted requests and offer a credit if needed. Customer notified: "we're investigating and temporarily routing requests to a stable variant; will follow up with root cause." :white_check_mark:

jason: Collected artifacts: `core.infer.12345` present on host-45, gdb backtrace shows crash inside attention kernel; timeline aligns with autoscaler event at 09:01:58 UTC. Uploading to /tmp/triage/1767777000.tar.gz.

mike: Quick config changes I'll push: disable autoscaler burst for checkout-enrich, set `max_concurrency=1` and `kv_prefetch=false` for now. Also opening an investigation ticket to revert quant-v2 until we patch kernel selection.

anya: Will keep ACME updated. Marking P1 for triage. @oncall please review the dump when available. Thanks everyone.
